get.description: Retrieve the rules associated with a specific pipeline in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to access governance validation rules and approval stages for the specified pipeline. It is useful for understanding the constraints and approval processes applied to the pipeline.

parameters.name: objectTypeId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the object type for which the pipeline rules are being retrieved.

parameters.name: pipelineId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the pipeline whose rules are being retrieved.

put.description: Update the rules for a specific pipeline in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to modify governance validation rules and approval stages associated with a pipeline. It requires specifying the object type and pipeline identifiers.

parameters.name: objectTypeId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the object type for which the pipeline rules are being updated.

parameters.name: pipelineId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the pipeline whose rules are being updated.

delete.description: Delete a specific set of pipeline rules associated with a given object type and pipeline ID in your HubSpot account. This operation is useful for removing obsolete or incorrect rules from a pipeline. Ensure that the objectTypeId and pipelineId are correctly specified to avoid unintended deletions.

parameters.name: objectTypeId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the object type associated with the pipeline rules to delete.

parameters.name: pipelineId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the pipeline whose rules are to be deleted.

patch.description: Update the rules for a specific pipeline within a given object type in HubSpot. This operation allows you to modify governance validation rules and approval stages for the specified pipeline. It is useful for maintaining or altering the workflow rules associated with your pipelines.

parameters.name: objectTypeId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the object type for which the pipeline rules are being updated.

parameters.name: pipelineId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the pipeline whose rules are being updated.

post.description: Initiate the approval process for a specific pipeline within a given object type. This endpoint is useful for triggering approval workflows that are associated with pipeline stages, ensuring that the necessary approvals are obtained before proceeding with further actions in the pipeline.

parameters.name: objectTypeId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the object type for which the approval process is being started.

parameters.name: pipelineId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the pipeline for which the approval process is being initiated.

get.description: Retrieve the approval status of a specific object within a pipeline. This endpoint is useful for checking the current approval state of an object, which can be critical in workflows that require validation or authorization steps.

parameters.name: objectId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the object for which the approval status is being retrieved.

parameters.name: objectTypeId
parameters.description: The unique identifier for the type of object being referenced.

parameters.name: pipelineId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the pipeline containing the object.

get.description: Retrieve the stage edit permissions for a specific pipeline in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to view the permissions set for editing stages within a given pipeline, identified by its object type and pipeline ID. This can be useful for managing access and ensuring that only authorized users can modify pipeline stages.

parameters.name: objectTypeId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the object type for which the pipeline stage edit permissions are being retrieved.

parameters.name: pipelineId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the pipeline whose stage edit permissions are being retrieved.

put.description: Update the stage edit permissions for a specific pipeline in your HubSpot account. This endpoint allows you to modify which users or teams have access to edit stages within a specified pipeline. It is useful for managing access control and ensuring that only authorized personnel can make changes to the pipeline stages.

parameters.name: objectTypeId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the object type associated with the pipeline.

parameters.name: pipelineId
parameters.description: The unique identifier of the pipeline for which stage edit permissions are being updated.
